description:
When Lee Ha-jin returned to ‘Battle Hero’ after finishing his military service, the game that was once #1 across internet cafés had turned into a complete dead game. Ha-jin, who used to be a Diamond-rank player, is now stuck in Silver rank as a lonely solo tanker trying to hold back enemy teams all by himself.

*“This won’t work. Next time I bump into someone actually decent, I’m kidnapping them into my squad.”*

That’s when user “Agijagi” (Cute-and-Tiny) appears playing a ninja character that feels like a matching pair with Ha-jin’s username, “Japojagi” (Despair-and-Surrender). Even while playing a garbage character, this melee DPS wipes the floor with a pentakill—possessing skills that clearly don’t belong in Silver.

However, when Ha-jin confidently sends a party invite, he gets an unexpected rejection:

[I don't really wanna party with guys >_<]

Facing match stats far too beautiful to give up on, Ha-jin even resorts to calling him *oppa* just to hold onto him.
His plan? Sucking up all the carry damage until he reaches the higher tiers, and then dumping him.

[Official PV](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oaO7tHix7l4) | [Character Profile](https://misc.ridibooks.com/desc.intro/6406000001)
